rationale: The dev's diff already patched dashboard-variables-auto-run.spec.js (outline -> primary in the flag-off pending flow) and the unit spec, so the pending->warning->primary transition and the Auto Run tooltip proxy are already covered. The two headline behaviors NOT covered anywhere in E2E are: (1) the default view-mode primary variant + visible 'Refresh' label + the refresh-options trigger mirroring primary, and (2) the layout-edit-mode demotion to outline (feature doc explicitly flags 'no existing E2E covers the Refresh outline variant here'). The refresh-button variant/label is its own coherent feature area (distinct slug, distinct spec_path in run-context), so a dedicated spec is warranted rather than appending to the Auto Run or layout-edit specs which test different features.
